It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its former rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}. {{nihongo|'''Taji Shrine'''|多治神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki Jinmyōchō}}. It is located in {{ill|Tamba Province|cs|Tanba (provincie)|de|Provinz Tamba|es|Provincia de Tanba|fa|ولایت تانبا|fr|Province de Tanba|gl|Provincia de Tanba|id|Provinsi Tamba|it|Tanba (provincia)|ja|丹波国|ko|단바국|lt|Tambos žemė|nl|Tamba (provincie)|pt|Província de Tanba|ru|Тамба (провинция)|simple|Tamba Province|sk|Tanba (provincia)|sr|Провинција Тамба|tr|Tamba (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Тамба|zh|丹波國|zh_min_nan|Tanba-kok|qid=Q954511|lt=Tamba Province}}.

== Enshrined deities ==
The two principal deities are:
* '''{{ill|Oyamakui no Kami|ja|大山咋神|simple|Oyamakui no Kami|zh|大山咋神|qid=Q10935105}}'''
* '''{{ill|Futodama|it|Futodama|ja|フトダマ|ru|Футодама|simple|Futodama|zh|布刀玉命|qid=Q11059539|lt=Ame-no-Futodama-no-Mikoto}}'''

== History ==
Shrine tradition says it was founded in the early {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178}}, during the {{ill|Keiun|ar|فترة كيون|de|Keiun|es|Keiun|fa|کیوئون|fr|Ère Keiun|ia|Keiun|id|Keiun|ja|慶雲|ko|게이운|ru|Кэйун|simple|Keiun|sr|Кеиун|th|เคอุง|tr|Keiun|uk|Кей'ун|zh|慶雲 (日本)|zh_yue|慶雲 (日本)|qid=Q428753}} era (704-707), by Tahara Sadaijin ({{ill|Prince Shiki|de|Shiki no Miko|ja|志貴皇子|ko|시키노미코|zh|志貴皇子|qid=Q11072254}}, also written Shiki no Miko), third imperial son of {{ill|Emperor Tenji|ar|الإمبراطور تينجي|azb|تنجی (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Tenji|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر تێنجی|cs|Tendži|de|Tenji|es|Tenji Tennō|fa|امپراتور تنجی|fi|Tenji|fr|Tenji (empereur)|hak|Tenji Thiên-fòng|he|טנג'י|hu|Tendzsi japán császár|id|Kaisar Tenji|it|Tenji|ja|天智天皇|ka|ტენძი|ko|덴지 천황|la|Tenji (imperator)|nl|Tenji|pl|Tenji|pt|Tenji|ru|Император Тэндзи|sh|Car Tenji|simple|Emperor Tenji|sl|Cesar Tendži|sr|Car Tendži|sv|Tenji|th|จักรพรรดิเท็นจิ|tl|Emperador Tenji|tr|Tenji (imparator)|uk|Імператор Тендзі|uz|Imperator Tenji|vi|Thiên hoàng Tenji|wuu|天智天皇|yo|Emperor Tenji|zh|天智天皇|zh_min_nan|Tenzi Thian-hông|zh_yue|天智天皇|qid=Q314802}}<ref>According to ''{{ill|Ruijū Sandai Kyaku|ja|類聚三代格|qid=Q11665185}}''. ''Shoku Nihongi'' entry for Reiki 2, 8th month, 11th day says seventh prince.</ref>.

In the mid-Heian ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}'', it is listed as "Tanuma Shrine" in Funai District, {{ill|Tanba Province|cs|Tanba (provincie)|de|Provinz Tamba|es|Provincia de Tanba|fa|ولایت تانبا|fr|Province de Tanba|gl|Provincia de Tanba|id|Provinsi Tamba|it|Tanba (provincia)|ja|丹波国|ko|단바국|lt|Tambos žemė|nl|Tamba (provincie)|pt|Província de Tanba|ru|Тамба (провинция)|simple|Tamba Province|sk|Tanba (provincia)|sr|Провинција Тамба|tr|Tamba (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Тамба|zh|丹波國|zh_min_nan|Tanba-kok|qid=Q954511}}, and ranked as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.

Because the settlement name at the shrine site was "Tahara-go," it is thought that the characters "Taji" came to be used, but a ridge tag from {{ill|1302|ab|1302|af|1302|als|1302|am|1302 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1302|ar|1302|ary|1302|arz|1302|ast|1302|avk|1302|az|1302|azb|۱۳۰۲ (میلادی)|bar|1302|be|1302|be_x_old|1302|bg|1302|bn|১৩০২|bpy|মারি ১৩০২|br|1302|bs|1302.|ca|1302|cdo|1302 nièng|ceb|1302|ckb|١٣٠٢|crh|1302|cs|1302|cv|1302|cy|1302|da|1302|de|1302|diq|1302|el|1302|eml|1302|eo|1302|es|1302|et|1302|eu|1302|fa|۱۳۰۲ (میلادی)|fi|1302|fo|1302|fr|1302|frr|1302|fy|1302|ga|1302|gan|1302年|gcr|1302|gd|1302|gl|1302|gv|1302|he|1302|hi|१३०२|hr|1302.|ht|1302 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1302|hy|1302|id|1302|ilo|1302|io|1302|is|1302|it|1302|ja|1302年|jv|1302|ka|1302|kaa|1302|kk|1302 жыл|ko|1302년|ksh|Joohr 1302|la|1302|lb|1302|lij|1302|lmo|1302|lt|1302 m.|lv|1302. gads|mai|१३०२|map_bms|1302|mdf|1302|mg|1302|mhr|1302|mi|1302|min|1302|mk|1302|mr|इ.स. १३०२|mrj|1302 и|ms|1302|my|၁၃၀၂|mzn|۱۳۰۲|nap|1302|nds|1302|nds_nl|1302|new|सन् १३०२|nl|1302|nn|1302|no|1302|nrm|1302|nso|1302|oc|1302|or|୧୩୦୨|os|1302-æм аз|pa|1302|pl|1302|pnb|1302|pt|1302|qu|1302|ro|1302|ru|1302 год|rue|1302|sa|१३०२|sah|1302|scn|1302|sd|1302ع|se|1302|sh|1302.|shn|1302|simple|1302|sk|1302|sl|1302|smn|1302|sq|1302|sr|1302|su|1302|sv|1302|sw|1302|ta|1302|tg|Соли 1302|th|พ.ศ. 1845|tk|1302|tl|1302|tly|1302|tr|1302|tt|1302 ел|uk|1302|ur|1302ء|uz|1302|vec|1302|vi|1302|vls|1302|wa|1302|war|1302|wuu|1302年|xmf|1302|zh|1302年|zh_min_nan|1302 nî|zh_yue|1302年|qid=Q5612}} ({{ill|Kengen|de|Kengen|fa|کنگن|fr|Ère Kengen|ia|Kengen|id|Kengen|ja|乾元 (日本)|ko|겐겐|ru|Кэнгэн|simple|Kengen|sr|Кенген (ера)|sv|Kengen|tr|Kengen|zh|乾元 (日本)|qid=Q1327472|lt=Kengen}} 1) in the Kamakura period reads "Tanuma Daimyojin," suggesting there was also a period when it was called "Tanuma"<ref>''Place Names of Kyoto Prefecture,'' section on Taji Shrine in Funai District.</ref>.

In Meiji 10, it was ranked as {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}} under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}}.
